newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt says seeks 20,000 to 30,000 T vegoils.
newsitem.headline: Egypt says seeks 20,000 to 30,000 T vegoils.

text.p: The Egytian state's Food Industries Company said on Monday it was seeking 20,000 to 30,000 tonnes of vegetable oils for delivery in July.
The oil may be either raw sunflower oil, semi-refined cottonseed oil, U.S. cottonseed oil of 162 degrees or degummed soyoil, it said.
The company wants 10,000 to 15,000 tonnes, plus or minus five percent, for delivery in the first half of July and the same amount for delivery in the second half of the month.
It will open bids at 0900 GMT on June 17.
